英文第36題｜resonate與move的情感字義

英文 / 綜合 / 綜合 · 對話建立日期（Created）：2026-08-14

分享原卷｜第36題

完整原題

作答所需文章／材料

【Taiwan Sensibility】 Cheez: Ever since I came to Taiwan, I started to love something special here. It touched my heart again and again. It’s hard to name, but it really resonates with me. Yu-shin: I guess you mean Taiwan Sensibility. Cheez: People here help others in simple ways. Yesterday, a stranger saw me looking worried at the bus stop. She didn’t just point the way — she stayed with me until the bus came. Yu-shin: That sounds like people here. We like to make sure others feel safe. Cheez: I can feel that. In my country, people are kind too, but sometimes we don’t show it so openly. In Taiwan, the care is right in front of you. It’s simple but strong. Yu-shin: Many people here grew up watching neighbors help each other. Maybe that shapes our Taiwan Sensibility today. Also, small things carry memories to us. A small temple, a simple bowl of rice, the sound of scooters, a quiet street in the morning. All those things bring us joy. Cheez: I went to a night market last night. I heard families talking and laughing. It made me miss home, but I didn’t feel lonely. Yu-shin: I’m really glad you feel safe here. Cheez: I do. Taiwan Sensibility makes me think more about my way of treating others. I want to be warmer, too. Yu-shin: Then Taiwan is already part of you. Cheez: Yes. This place will always feel like home to me. 【原題字詞註釋】memory：記憶。
Which word can Cheez use to mean resonate? (A) Feel. (B) Follow. (C) Love. (D) Move.
先想一想，再查看答案、解說與原圖
原卷作答：D（原卷及對話練習均選D）
正確答案：D，Move。

逐項解析

選項與原句判讀句意與判斷理由
(A)
Feel.		不選

feel指感覺、感受；本處要表達事情打動一個人的心，move更貼近。

(B)
Follow.		不選

follow指跟隨，與前文touched my heart的情緒意義不符。

(C)
Love.		不選

love指喜愛，不是此處讓人產生共鳴、受到觸動的動作。

(D)
Move.		應選

move可表示打動、使感動，與touched my heart及resonate呼應。

詳細說明與解題步驟

一、回到目標字前一句
Cheez先說It touched my heart again and again，表示那種特別的感受一次次觸動他的心。接著才說it really resonates with me，所以這裡不是物理上的共振聲響，而是引起共鳴、觸動心情。

二、選同樣能表達打動人的動詞
move除了移動，也有打動、使感動的意思，與此處的resonate最接近，故選D。resonates with me可用moves me表達相近意思；意思相近不表示原介系詞with也要照搬。

三、區別感受與使人感動
feel是感覺、感受，follow是跟隨，love是喜愛；本題強調那件事觸動Cheez的心，用move最能呼應前文。字義題要把選項放回情境比較，不能只背move的第一個中文意思「移動」。
